description: SAVED MIS data class; requires fresh saved-MIS consent. Discover the canonical current Entity MIS for any requested reporting period, including earlier periods, using a live offset catalogue. Superseded versions are not accessible. Available sealed working, submitted and approved output is readable; approval is not required, and retrieval never approves a run. Disclose the actual approval status. Pending/running/failed/cancelled work has no saved numerical output. Use the returned physical run_id for catalogue and number reads; the returned version is a source citation, not a selector. This does not generate MIS. Group access and other report families are still being added.

offset.description: Live catalogue offset; results can change between calls.
